findings.evidence: All 40 plan source_hashes match local bytes; all 34 backend pins match blobs in source commit 01439703d647ab17246c4f9c821a4dd05b5b2a99. That commit is contained in origin/main. The harness also fails closed on backend drift and rechecks plan/source before dispatch.

Recomputed the exact author wire, native schema, prompts, config, and canonical request hashes from frozen plan/request bytes. Wire and schema match the predecessor v12 author plan. The offline preflight validates the 2,357-byte JSON schema and Converse input shape.

Direct 10-case test suite passed. The harness --preflight passed with provider_calls=0. A second preflight with socket.connect and socket.create_connection blocked throughout parent import/build also passed. No AWS provider request was initiated.

Exactly one mixed job and five original slots are materialized; the frozen request allocates three arithmetic and two English slots. A durable six-slot reservation precedes Converse, SDK total_max_attempts is one, connect timeout is three seconds, read timeout is capped at 200 seconds, and SIGALRM covers the 240-second execute interval beginning before credential export and STS.

Offline build and --preflight do not call AWS. The distinct --launch-precheck path intentionally permits one STS identity request and possible login refresh during profile resolution or CLI credential export; it records a one-shot attempt and requires at least 360 seconds of credential life. Execute exports a fresh snapshot requiring at least 300 seconds and makes at most one additional STS identity request. The CLI login refresh count is declared unobserved in the plan.

The mapped runtime breaks after its initial batch, and harness guards reject a second author stage or changed request. Empty fallback model, exact request/model checks, one-shot capture, and absence of bank, queue, or deployment calls prevent a retry, repair, top-up, fallback, or downstream write in this harness.

Credential fields remain in memory; captured errors retain only bounded type/code. Provider visible text is bounded, exact credential echoes are rejected before persistence, decoded JSON strings are checked, and native reasoning is omitted. The capture records original-slot provenance and policy revisions; qualification requires all five original slots, revisions 8/8/8/10/10, exact 3:2 allocation, independent keys, six meaningful choice pairs per item, sound teaching, English difficulty 2–3, and full execute timing within 240 seconds.
